protocol.classification: stored legacy spatial-path threshold labels; no new significance classification
protocol.control_pool: all non-PGC units; same count matched on independently calibrated mean and RMS activity and outgoing recurrent-column norm
protocol.perturbation: same initially normal small rate disturbance, orthogonal to empirical x/y translation tangents and state scaling; positivity preserved; subsequent total separation is measured
protocol.mean_replacement_vector: independent valid-trajectory calibration mean, constant across evaluation states/time
protocol.stability_reference: perturbed and unperturbed trajectories under the identical gated recurrence
protocol.gating: selected source-unit output into recurrence only; input/encoder/decoder and initial states unchanged
protocol.readout_only_control: native recurrence; PGC contribution masked only when computing original decoder output
